title: pytorch.org/get-started/locally is wrong about supported Python version (3.12 is not highest)
bug_description:
### 📚 The doc issue

I use Pytorch under Windows-10 + Python 3.13 + pytorch 2.7 + 2.8.
pip allows install from 3.9 to 3.13.  see  https://pypi.org/project/torch/

There is an outdated statement on your page:
> Currently, PyTorch on Windows only supports Python 3.9-3.12; Python 2.x is not supported.
https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/#supported-windows-distributions


### Suggest a potential alternative/fix

change the text on the website.

cc @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke
error_description: The documentation page states 'Currently, PyTorch on Windows only supports Python 3.9-3.12; Python 2.x is not supported.' but pip allows installation from Python 3.9 to 3.13 according to https://pypi.org/project/torch/.
